Progress Note for Roger:

Session Date: [Insert Date]
Session Time: [Insert Time]
Client: Roger

Presenting Issues: Roger is struggling with anxiety and depression, which are impacting his ability to focus and function daily. He reports feeling off and experiencing a lack of motivation, which is causing distress.

Assessment: Roger's anxiety and depression scores are 2 and 3, respectively, indicating a moderate level of distress. He is currently residing at the Turning Point shelter and is collecting disability for Traumatic Brain Injury (TBI). He has a history of substance use, but reports no current desire to use due to the negative impact it has on his life.

Intervention: During the session, Roger and I discussed his history of substance use and its effects on his life. I also explored his current coping mechanisms and strategies for managing his anxiety and depression. We worked on developing a plan to improve his focus and productivity, including setting realistic goals and breaking tasks into smaller, manageable steps.

Response: Roger reported feeling more hopeful and motivated after our discussion, and expressed a desire to continue working on his goals. He acknowledged the challenges he faces, but was willing to take small steps towards improving his focus and overall well-being.

Goals for Next Session: Roger will continue to work on developing his coping mechanisms and strategies for managing his anxiety and depression. He will also begin to implement the plan we discussed, focusing on setting realistic goals and breaking tasks into smaller steps.

Rating Scale: 2 (mild) and 3 (moderate) anxiety and depression scores indicate a moderate level of distress. Roger's lack of focus is distressing, but he is willing to work on improving it.

Note: Roger's progress will be closely monitored, and adjustments to his treatment plan will be made as needed.
